qualification.reason: This is a Request for Quotations (RFQ) issued by the NYS Office of General Services for an Aggregate Hardware Buy, including detailed scope, submission deadlines, evaluation criteria, and terms and conditions.

quotes.quote: Request for Quotations 20-01 Aggregate Hardware Buy

OGS is seeking competitive quotes from Contract holders of the OGS Group 73600 Award 22802 Information Technology Umbrella Contract – Manufacturer Based (Statewide) (“Manufacturer Umbrella Contract”) for the Lots indicated below.

OGS is releasing this Request for Quotes (RFQ) for Aggregate Hardware Buy 20-01 (“RFQ 20-01”). The purpose of RFQ 20-01 is to establish an award for each Configuration as set forth in Attachment A - Technical Response.

findings.title: Delivery Extension Approval Process
findings.fact: The document states that Authorized Users may request extension beyond 60 days, but also states that approval of substantially delayed deliveries (over 60 days) will be limited to industry-wide events or extenuating circumstances, and final determination is at OGS's sole discretion.
findings.business_implication: There is ambiguity regarding the process for obtaining extensions beyond 60 days, which may create uncertainty for the bidder.
findings.action_recommendation: Clarify with OGS the exact process and criteria for approving extensions beyond 60 days.

quotes.quote: If an Authorized User wants to extend the delivery period beyond sixty (60) calendar days, the Authorized User may submit a written request to extend the Product delivery period beyond sixty (60) calendar days to OGS for its approval.

Approval of substantially delayed deliveries (over 60 calendar days), when the delayed delivery will impact more than one order fulfillment in a thirty (30) day time frame for more than 75 calendar days per incident, will be limited to delays that are a result of an industry wide event or other acceptable extenuating circumstance, that limits or prohibits Contractor’s ability to deliver within Agreement delivery timeframes.

findings.title: Audit Cost Liability for Underpayment
findings.fact: If, as a result of any such audit, Administrative Fees are determined to have been underpaid by more than five percent (5%) for the period audited, Contractor shall pay the costs of such audit or three times the discrepancy, whichever is higher.
findings.business_implication: The bidder faces significant financial penalties if administrative fees are underpaid by more than 5%, including audit costs or treble damages.
findings.action_recommendation: Implement robust sales reporting and fee calculation processes to avoid underpayment and potential penalties.

quotes.quote: If, as a result of any such audit, Administrative Fees are determined to have been underpaid by more than five percent (5%) for the period audited, Contractor shall pay the costs of such audit or three times the discrepancy, whichever is higher.

findings.business_implication: Bidders must ensure their website does not inadvertently allow ordering outside the eMarketplace.
findings.action_recommendation: Review website functionality to ensure compliance with ordering restrictions.

quotes.quote: The Contractors website shall not have a web-based ordering system with the capability of receiving orders from Authorized Users.

If after establishing an eMarketplace account, the Contractor opts to maintain its own Aggregate Hardware Buy website, the eMarketplace link must be the only ordering system link displayed on the page.

quotes.quote: Electronic media shall be included on Microsoft Windows formatted USB flash drives and should be clearly labeled as set forth below. All Contractor Submissions shall be saved in separate unprotected files in Microsoft Office products (Word and Excel) in Products release 2012 or higher.

Two (2) digital storage devices (USB flash drive), clearly labeled, shall contain the following documents, completed in their entirety: • Attachment A – Technical Response • Attachment D – Issue Escalation Plan • Manufacturer Information Page (Last page of this Document)

quotes.quote: Technical Response (Attachment A – Technical Response, Attachment D – Issue Escalation Plan, and Manufacturer Information Page): Pass/Fail Financial Response : 100% Total Financial Score is based on lowest cost and the points are weighted as follows: • Standard Configuration - 50 points • Required Products o Warranty/Services - 15 points o Components - 30 points o Peripherals - 5 points

In addition, in the event that the Awarded Contractor believes it necessary to prioritize orders made by extension of this Agreement to customers outside of New York State Authorized Users, over orders placed under this originating Agreement for New York State Authorized Users, the Awarded Contractor must contact OGS for approval prior to fulfilling such orders.
